Required local may be read before assignment: enum_type
S2S non-void function derives_from can reach the end without returning a value
S2S local initializer is already declared in this scope
Ownership selection requires two same-family handles

S2S needs an established local declaration for native
S2S non-void function prepare can reach the end without returning a value
